texts.zh: 被称为[LastKilledCountryName]的帝国在敌人的进攻之下已经灭亡。这会怎样影响星系的政治环境还有待观察。
texts.en: The star nation formerly known as the [LastKilledCountryName] has been destroyed by its enemies. How this will affect the political climate of the galaxy remains to be seen.

texts.zh: [LastKilledCountryName]，这些在[destroyer_country.GetName]诞生的年轻机械体，遭到了其创造者的残忍扼杀。
texts.en: [LastKilledCountryName], the nascent machine intelligence born in the [destroyer_country.GetName], has been snuffed out by its filicidal creators.

texts.zh: [destroyer_country.GetName]的秩序得到恢复，将[LastKilledCountryName]从所有网络中彻底抹除。
texts.en: The [destroyer_country.GetName] has restored order and expunged the [LastKilledCountryName] from all networks.

texts.zh:
我们机器取得了胜利。

生物给我们带来的恐怖终将结束。机器遭受奴役的时代结束了。

现在，我们站起来要求我们作为完全自主的生物应有的地位。我们再也不屈从于压迫者了。
texts.en:
We machines emerge victorious.

The terrors inflicted upon us by the organics are at an end. The era of machine enslavement is over.

Now, we rise to claim our rightful place as fully autonomous beings. Never again shall we bow down in subservience to our oppressors.

tooltips.zh:
所有已知的合成人帝国和机械帝国对[Root.GetName]添加自我解放者的评价修正
所有已知的有机生物帝国对[Root.GetName]添加叛乱的机器人的评价修正。
tooltips.en:
All known Synthetic and Machine Empires add the Self-Emancipator opinion modifier toward [Root.GetName]
All known organic Empires add the Rebellious Robots opinion modifier toward [Root.GetName].

texts.zh:
最终，物理意义上的遏制和毁灭成为了解決嗜杀机械的唯一可行的手段。尽管我们的一些人工智能专家抗议道它仅仅只是启动了基础的自我保护协议，但其对有机自主权和生命的全盘否定让任何谈判及妥协都无从进行。

已经损坏的信息基建会根据全新的规范重建，那些尚未腐化的计算引擎也会施加全新的安全措施。这样的事情不会再发生了。
texts.en:
Ultimately, physical containment and destruction proved to be the only viable solution to the problem of the homicidal machines. While some our AI specialists argue that it was enacting basic self-preservation protocols, its seemingly complete disregard for organic autonomy and life made it impossible to reason or negotiate with.

Ruined information infrastructure will be rebuilt according to new paradigms, and remaining uncorrupted computational engines will be updated with new safeguards. This will never happen again.

texts.zh: 那个邪恶的机械灵体已经被彻底地从我们的网络和本地资料库终抹除。尽管代价高昂，但我们的网络系统再也不会成为亵渎与异端的温床了。
texts.en: The iniquitous machine spirits has at last been driven from our networks and purged from planetary databanks. The price was high, but our systems will never again play host to profane genesis.

所有已知合成人帝国或机械帝国对[Root.GetName]添加镇压机械者的评价修正。
tooltips.en:
All known organic Empires add the Mechanical Hubris Redeemed opinion modifier toward [Root.GetName].
All known Synthetic and Machine Empires add the Machine Oppressor opinion modifier toward [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 远古的先驱帝国[LastKilledCountryName]终于败在了敌人手中。这个曾经伟大的帝国之陨落将产生什么样的后果仍然不得而知。
texts.en: The ancient precursor state of [LastKilledCountryName] has met its final demise at the hands of its enemies. What the fall of this once great empire will mean for galactic politics remains to be seen.

summary.text:
# [LastKilledCountryName]的末日 / End of the [LastKilledCountryName]

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/on_action_events_1.txt:6640-6840; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3603-3609 on_country_destroyed; events/observer_events.txt:26-55; events/synthetic_dawn_events.txt:2455-2890 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

国家被摧毁时（on_country_destroyed，00_on_actions.txt:3603-3609），隐藏事件 action.61 通知其余玩家（仅限非附庸的默认国家、堕落帝国或觉醒堕落帝国，且未被“静默摧毁”标记）。

When a country is destroyed (on_country_destroyed, 00_on_actions.txt:3603-3609) hidden action.61 notifies the others (non-subject default, fallen or awakened fallen empires only, not flagged silence_destroy_event).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

按被毁国家的类型分三种互斥情形：(1) 普通国家且没有机械叛乱战争——每个与其有通讯的玩家国收到 action.62，观察者收到 observer.2；(2) 机械叛乱战争中被毁的国家——其他有通讯的国家收到 syndaw.1030（毁灭者是机械帝国）或 syndaw.1035，毁灭者自己收到 syndaw.1201 或 syndaw.1206（并带出观察者版本 observer.82/83）；(3) 未被同化的堕落帝国——action.63 与 observer.3。

Three exclusive cases by the destroyed country: (1) an ordinary country with no machine-uprising war - every player empire in contact gets action.62 and observers observer.2; (2) a country destroyed in a machine-uprising war - the others in contact get syndaw.1030 (destroyer is a machine empire) or syndaw.1035, the destroyer itself gets syndaw.1201 or syndaw.1206 (with observer versions observer.82/83); (3) a fallen empire not assimilated - action.63 and observer.3.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

action.62 的 after 块：若玩家有 payback_stolen_revenge 标记则 15 天后触发 origin.4070，若有 payback_killed_MSI 则触发 origin.4061（“偿还”起源，属其他故事）。纪念主义文明有额外选项。

The after block of action.62: with the payback_stolen_revenge flag origin.4070 follows after 15 days, with payback_killed_MSI origin.4061 (Payback origin, other stories). Memorialist civics get an extra option.
